summary: Train on oil and gas decommissioning and environmental compliance with practical tools, registers, and reporting workflows. Build confidence and audit readiness
lede: Oil and gas decommissioning training covers asset retirement planning, environmental risk controls, and documentation of closure actions. For engineers, environmental compliance professionals, and HSE leads, it builds practical skills in mapping obligations to work, planning shutdown and remediation controls, and preparing inspection evidence. Exercises include developing compliance matrices, waste and remediation logs, restoration checklists, and closure dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to manage the environmental side of oil and gas asset retirement with structure and credibility. It suits roles that work directly with shutdown execution, remediation, compliance evidence, and leadership reporting.
outcomes: Waste Classification And Chain Of Custody
prerequisites: You should bring a basic understanding of oil and gas asset operations, environmental compliance documentation, or project coordination. A laptop is recommended for working on templates, registers, and digital reporting exercises.
